users_login_identifier.name: users_login_identifier
users_login_identifier.value: "users"."email" is not null or "users"."username" is not null

fee_charges_fee_type_kind.name: fee_charges_fee_type_kind
fee_charges_fee_type_kind.value: ("fee_charges"."kind" in ('monthly', 'registration')) = ("fee_charges"."fee_type_id" is null and "fee_charges"."description" is null)

fee_charges_month_kind.name: fee_charges_month_kind
fee_charges_month_kind.value: ("fee_charges"."kind" = 'monthly') = ("fee_charges"."month" is not null) and ("fee_charges"."month" is null or extract(day from "fee_charges"."month") = 1)

fee_payments_reversal.name: fee_payments_reversal
fee_payments_reversal.value: ("fee_payments"."status" = 'reversed') = ("fee_payments"."reversed_at" is not null and "fee_payments"."reversal_reason" is not null)

subject_marks_parts_range.name: subject_marks_parts_range
subject_marks_parts_range.value: "subject_marks"."midterm" between 0 and 100 and "subject_marks"."activities" between 0 and 100 and "subject_marks"."final" between 0 and 100

salary_payments_reversal.name: salary_payments_reversal
salary_payments_reversal.value: ("salary_payments"."status" = 'reversed') = ("salary_payments"."reversed_at" is not null and "salary_payments"."reversal_reason" is not null)
